taglineIntent: an investment seminar for members: learn from named speakers, reserve a seat
moodIntent: an evening of expert talks on markets and planning; calm authority, a clear agenda and limited seats

components.name: Speaker card
components.role: introduce one speaker and their topic
components.contentNotes: portrait image slot, name, title, talk title, one-line takeaway

components.name: Agenda timeline
components.role: lay out the evening session by session
components.contentNotes: time, session title, speaker name; breaks marked plainly

components.name: Seat reservation form
components.role: reserve a seat in one step
components.contentNotes: name, phone, member number, session choice, consent line, the main action

components.name: Seats-left call-out
components.role: state the date, venue and remaining seats
components.contentNotes: date, venue, seats left, the main action

dos: name the speaker's credentials in their card, not in the hero
donts: promise returns or outcomes in session titles, because seminar copy is educational, not advice
promptInputs: a speaker card with portrait and talk title
an agenda timeline for an evening of three talks
